_what: The finding the drawn auditor files in review on Balancer's row, in words. The cell receives only hashes: every commitment in the claim is the keccak256 of one string below, read by Review.sol at run time. Change a word here and every hash follows. The _pins are the values the tests find again in the files they came from.

invariant.statement: on an exact-out swap every rounding on the path goes in the direction that benefits the pool, the upscaling of the amount out and of the balances included, so the amount in the pool asks for is never less than the trade is worth
invariant._missing_from: spec/swap-rounding-v0.json. It states each step's rounding as the pool's own comments state it, and upscaling-rounds-down-for-every-amount is the step that rounds against the pool on an exact-out swap: the amount out is made smaller before the math prices it. Balancer's comment on that line says the impact is expected to be minimal because there is no rounding error unless the scaling factor is overridden, and this pool overrides it (ComposableStablePoolRates.sol line 302). Nothing in the spec says the steps taken together must favour the pool.
